automated_actions_allowed: Read and validate already-authored SOURCE, TARGET, BOUNDARY, envelope, acceptance, and instance records.
Compute SHA-256 values from frozen bytes and generate a primary-run manifest.
Compile an AUTHOR_ACCEPTED instance through the existing frozen VBE compiler and Corpus wrapper.
Check provenance reachability and cross-record identity consistency.
Replace report-only inherited scaffold display metadata with identity fields copied from the frozen TARGET lane while asserting adapter and source-contract bytes remain unchanged.
Copy empirical evidence into compiled-case binding paths by exact SHA-256 identity.
Execute the already-selected verifier command and preserve valid semantic exit codes 0, 10, and 20 as scientific outcomes rather than CI failures.
Create deterministic, self-contained archives containing the complete compiled case tree and verifier output.
automated_actions_forbidden: Infer a source consequence from target behavior or a prior RISU result.
Choose or change a target pattern, world set, effect cut, admissibility rule, claim strength, or evidence-strength label.
Invent missing evidence facts or silently strengthen evidence.
Automatically repair a provenance gap after AUTHOR_ACCEPTED freeze.
Convert PRESERVED, CONSEQUENCE_REGRESSION, or INCOMPLETE_ASSURANCE into a preferred outcome.
fail_closed_rules: Missing or inconsistent semantic fields block primary execution.
Any ESTABLISHED derivation fact not upstream of the EXACT claim blocks primary execution before the verifier.
Any frozen-byte mismatch blocks primary execution.
Any empirical evidence binding that cannot be mapped one-to-one by SHA-256 to a frozen evidence path blocks primary execution.
Verifier/toolchain exit codes outside 0, 10, and 20 are infrastructure failures and must expose and archive diagnostics.
objective: Remove mechanical error and packaging friction without automating or rewriting scientific judgment.

self-contained bundle test proves full compiled tree retention
